t: A half-day plan where students train a container robot to win at hexapawn.
steps: Find the DiscoverE plan titled AI Machine Learning (Hexapawn).
Read the student handout on how to play.
Gather cardboard, pawns, 24 containers, and colored markers.
Assemble the board and containers, or pre-assemble them for students.
Plan a half day for play, discussion, and redesign.
Check the rights notice before copying the handout.
